prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset.","S02":"The flip-flops must be reset to 0x34 rather than zero.","S03":"All DFFs should be triggered by the negative edge of clk."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":8,"reset":1},"outputs":{"q":8},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"Q","meaning":"8-bit flip-flop output register, reset value 0x34","update_time":"negedge of clk","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R1_sync_reset","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 1 (overrides d on same negedge)","edge":"negedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":10,"reset":1},{"d":20,"reset":0},{"d":30,"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":52},{"q":20},{"q":30}]}},{"id":"R2_dff_capture","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 0","edge":"negedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"All DFFs should be triggered by the negative edge of clk","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"reset":0},{"d":2,"reset":0},{"d":3,"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":1},{"q":2},{"q":3}]}},{"id":"R3_reset_value","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 1 at negedge","edge":"negedge","visible":"same_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"reset to 0x34 rather than zero","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":0,"reset":1},{"d":0,"reset":1},{"d":0,"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":52},{"q":52},{"q":0}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"q":52},"first_released_cycle":"first negedge with reset==0"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[{"rule_id":"R1_sync_reset","note":"Spec states synchronous reset but does not explicitly state same-cycle vs next-cycle visibility.","candidates":["reset visible same negedge (same_cycle)","reset visible next negedge (next_cycle)"]}]}
